verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes an API, a Go SDK and a Terraform provider for DNS configuration, so automation is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows no first-party feature to version, review or roll back automations. Any versioning or rollback through Terraform state or git would be a user-side workaround built on developer building blocks, not a Namecheap capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
